prompt: Implement a class `CircularBuffer` with `CircularBuffer(capacity: int)`, `write(item) -> bool` (returns False if full, True if written), `read() -> item or None` (returns None if empty, else the oldest unread item, FIFO order), and `is_full()`/`is_empty()`.
test_suite:
import unittest

class Test(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fifo_order(self):
        b = CircularBuffer(3)
        b.write(1); b.write(2); b.write(3)
        self.assertEqual(b.read(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(b.read(), 2)
    def test_full_rejects_write(self):
        b = CircularBuffer(2)
        b.write(1); b.write(2)
        self.assertFalse(b.write(3))
    def test_wraps_around(self):
        b = CircularBuffer(2)
        b.write(1); b.write(2)
        b.read()
        self.assertTrue(b.write(3))
        self.assertEqual(b.read(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(b.read(), 3)
    def test_empty_read(self):
        b = CircularBuffer(2)
        self.assertIsNone(b.read())

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
